rationale_by_leg.zai-glm-5p2: Clean, uniform format and mostly faithful. WH framework, GPT-Live and the reproduction angle are all well-grounded (weak-plate quote, danshipper unit-distance, White House trio all verified). But emphasis is off: it buries OpenAI's own tonight formalization + Lean-cert release into background, misses the independent Vals eval (#10/43) that contradicts the Qwen hype entirely, and pads with a Jul-28 Kimi-on-Perplexity item dressed as current signal. Asserts 'Astra, OpenAI's next model family' as fact though the snapshot's own fact-check says OpenAI never named it. Source chip Alibaba_Qwen points to a jeremyphoward URL.
rationale_by_leg.claude: Stronger editorial read: leads with the genuinely-new OpenAI institutional signature + $2,000/Lean-cert artifacts (verbatim-exact), pairs it with the cross-lab reproduction correctly flagged single-source, and surfaces the independent Vals composite (66.1, #2 open-weight, #10/43) that A omits. Broader, all-fresh coverage (MiniMax H3, Moondream, SemiAnalysis, Locus) and markedly better source hygiene: debunks the cyber-singularity causal chain and the 'surpassed Fable 5' hype with grounded evidence. Minor: story 3 lacks a Context block; a couple Locus figures are chart-sourced but flagged directional.
